Title: Umbricians Live View
Description: A real-time Live View dashboard for the Umbraco Settings section that charts active web, member, backoffice, MCP and API sessions and custom metrics, lists who is online, and messages backoffice users and members.

Screenshots.Caption: The Live View dashboard: session counts per channel, a live chart of members logging in and out, and the online tables
The Members online table: members with pictures or initials, tagged Website, MCP or both

Relevant for set to Custom… with 2 hours 30 minutes, and the line saying when the message stops being shown
